This plot is rented, so I do not want to put too much money into it — if the owner takes it back, I lose what I spent. But maize here in Mbeya does well when the rains come, and my neighbors who use a little fertilizer get much more than those who use none. I will buy one bag of urea if I can find the cash, and I save manure from my few goats for the planting holes. I plant the improved seed I bought last season from the agro-dealer in town because it gave me more cobs than the local one, but I cannot afford to spray — I weed with my own hands and my older daughter helps me.
